The '''LongView-382.X''' was a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It was employed by [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-side [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outposts, such as outpost [[DVL-181]].<ref name="HS" />

The [[LongView-341.A]] was a scaled-down version of the LongView-382.X.<ref name="LbE">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref>
